# Create Z3 solver
solver = Solver()

# Create Z3 function for durations
durations = Function('durations', IntSort(), IntSort())
for city, dur in city_durations.items():
    solver.add(durations(city) == dur)

# Create variables for the sequence (7 cities)

# Constraints for the sequence

# 2. First city is Vienna (0)

    (2, 6), (6, 2),  # Rome-Oslo

    (0, 3), (3, 0),  # Vienna-Riga
    (0, 2), (2, 0),  # Vienna-Rome
    (1, 6), (6, 1),  # Milan-Oslo
